title: TSMC Verifies Fully Functional 90 Nanometer Chips Using Immersion Lithography Tools

passages.note: Main paragraphs 1 and 3–5. TSMC reported on a December 1 keynote disclosing functional 90 nm SRAM after an ASML immersion exposure at a critical layer. Exposed wafers returned to TSMC for fabrication. The release names the supplier and describes the prototype without giving a model number.
